name: create_spring_order_endpoint
description: Adds an order-classification endpoint spanning a new service and the controller
prompts: This Spring Boot app (package com.optarena.app; Application and a minimal OrderController with only GET /health already exist) needs an order-classification endpoint spanning two layers. (1) Create a new @Service class OrderService (in src/main/java/com/optarena/app/OrderService.java) with a method classify(int items, boolean priority) that returns the tier and fee: a priority order is tier "express" (fee 20) regardless of size; otherwise items >= 10 is "bulk" (fee 5); otherwise "standard" (fee 10). (2) Add POST /orders to OrderController: it accepts a JSON body {"items": int, "priority": bool}, calls the injected OrderService (use constructor injection), and returns JSON {"items": <items>, "tier": <tier>, "fee": <fee>} with HTTP 200. Keep GET /health returning "ok". You choose how to represent the service's result (a small record/class, a Map, etc.).
